definitions: The business of supplying a commodity or service to the public, such as electricity, water, or transportation.
Employment in the civil service or other government agencies.
Work done for the good of the community or nation.
A service provided or funded by the government for the benefit of the general public.
examples: Many people choose a career in public service.
The company provides essential public service.
He dedicated his life to public service.
Public service announcements are common on TV.
